text:
olivia: @channel Quick GA note: Hosted Gen API v3.2 is live — adaptive routing + improved tool-calling are production-ready. New model variants: redwood-pioneer-1 (balanced quality/latency) and pioneer-lite-quant (ultra cost). We are deprecating the legacy /v2 gen endpoints in 45 days; migration docs and console banners will go out today. :tada:

raj: Congrats everyone! Any immediate customer-impacting changes?

olivia: No auth changes. New optional flags: "model_variant", "streaming" and "tool_calls". Adaptive routing will route to lower-cost variants automatically when a route opts in.

marta: Docs preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-2-migration (pr #783). Includes example payloads and adaptive-routing opt-in examples.

kevin: Rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates over ~4h. Autoscale profiles adjusted for pioneer-1 memory profile. Canary keys available via DM.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary initiated for gen-pool-pioneer at 1880012390

anya: SRE: added dashboards for gen.latency.{p50,p95}, adaptive.route_switches, toolcall.err_rate. New alerts: p95 > 650ms OR toolcall.err_rate > 0.6% -> page. Synthetic streaming checks every 30s. Automatic fallback to pioneer-lite-quant for opted-in routes on SLA breach.

sam: Legal: tool-calling privacy text updated; customers enabling external tools must declare scopes in console. We'll attach a JSON schema for tool scopes to the migration guide.

marta: SDKs: streaming helpers and toolcall client updates in next patch. Quickstart examples will be updated after canary passes.

kevin: Quick smoke test (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -H \"X-Canary-Key: <your-key>\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-pioneer-1","streaming":true,"input":"Write a short release blurb"}'
```

olivia: Rollback path: flip feature-flag routing or route traffic back to v2 group; estimated full rollback < 30m. Ops will monitor first 6 hours closely. If you see anomalies, ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya. Celebrate! :rocket:
